name: xshelf
description: Browser extension that backs up X/Twitter bookmarks (text, full-res media, metadata) and renders a local explorer.

scripts.build:firefox: npm run build:templates && wxt build -b firefox
scripts.build:templates: npm run build:snapshot && npm run build:master && npm run build:shelf
scripts.zip:firefox: npm run build:templates && wxt zip -b firefox
scripts.icons: for s in 16 32 48 96 128; do rsvg-convert -w $s -h $s src/assets/icon.svg -o src/public/icon/$s.png; done
